title: BoneFit: Multimodal Prehabilitation for People Preparing for Orthopaedic Surgery
official: BoneFit: A Student-led Multimodal Prehabilitation Service for Orthopaedic Surgical Patients in Hull
summary: To conduct a pilot feasibility study to determine the effect of a student-led prehabilitation service in people awaiting total hip or knee replacement surgery.
